title: The Loop
aesthetic: melancholic driving synthwave — a lone wanderer's theme carried over a rising-danger undercurrent; reflective but always moving forward, like the platformer it scores

main_theme._comment: The wanderer's hook, D minor. A rising question that lands open on the 2nd (E), answered by a phrase that tops out on a new high (F5) and resolves home to D. Stepwise and singable, with a clear rhythmic fingerprint.

danger._comment: The rising-clock undercurrent — an unstable leaning phrase using the b2 (Eb, Neapolitan color) and the C# leading tone. Sits low, never resolves comfortably.
